name: Arachno-Bot
maker: Fraunhofer Institute of Manufacturing Engineering and Automation
def: Eight legged spider inspired robot developed in 2011 at the Fraunhofer Institute of Manufacturing Engineering and Automation in Stuttgart to survey areas too dangerous for people.
facts: Each leg uses an electrohydraulic soft joint modeled on a spider's
Mostly plastic, produced by 3D printing with selective laser sintering
Able to crawl, climb and jump
